messages:
tara_sales: Quick escalation 1: Cerulean Health POC. They attempted to create a dedicated GPU pool in ap-south1 for an on-site demo and it never reaches Ready. Demo scheduled tomorrow. Can runtime + platform triage?

marie_cs: Customer pasted UI error: 
```
PoolController: attach failed: AttachDeviceError: no devices available
Reason: quotaExceeded (requested 4 GPUs, available 0)
Also: ImagePullBackOff for registry.redwood-inference/private-runtime:v2.1
```

rahul_eng_runtime: Sounds like two failure modes - cloud quota and image auth. Did they set reservation=best-effort or reserved?

tara_sales: They picked "best-effort" and asked for AZ-aware placement (latency sensitive) but not strict reservation.

anya_platform: If best-effort + AZ preference we should not be invoking strict reservation allocator. Quota-bot run?

quota-bot: [quota-scan] ap-south1: t4 limit=12, in-use=12, reserved_by_customers=2

leo_support: Quota exhausted. That explains attach/no devices. On image pull: do their nodes have the registry pull secret? If not, kubelet will keep retrying and node init may never finish which blocks pool scaling.

marie_cs: Their onboarding flow used the "self-serve" token; procurement said it covers public images only. Private runtime needs an extra secret we provide for Dedicated POCs.

rahul_eng_runtime: Actionable plan: 1) confirm cloud project/account id and open expedited quota bump with cloud ops; 2) verify node bootstrap includes the registry pull secret and correct docker credential; 3) check kernel/nvidia driver mismatch in node logs in case AttachDeviceError is a driver issue, not only quota.

leo_support: I grabbed logs from a failed node: 
```
Oct 21 14:05:12 kubelet: device-plugin unhealthy: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection refused
Oct 21 14:05:13 kernel: nvidia: probe failed, error -19 (ENODEV)
Oct 21 14:05:15 containerd: pulling image "registry.redwood-inference/private-runtime:v2.1": unauthorized: authentication required
```

anya_platform: ENODEV + unauthorized -> two independent roots. For demo timeline we have options: A) request quota bump (may be slow); B) offer a "POC-burst" on our shared fleet in the same region if legal approves the temporary routing; C) move the demo to a region with capacity and enable a strict data path (customers can accept if we set up tunnel/VPN).

tara_sales: Customer insists on ap-south1 due to compliance. Can sales request a dedicated reserve (short term) from ops? What's lead time?

leo_support: Reserved capacity needs SA/ops approval. We can propose a one-off short-term reservation (4 T4s) as an enterprise POC addendum. Ops will need SOW + billing pre-authorization. Lead time: 4-8 hours if infra on-call approves and cloud quota bump is coordinated; can be longer if legal needs to review.

marie_cs: Pricing ask: what is the cost delta for "POC-burst" on shared fleet vs reserved T4s? Customer wants an hourly estimate to decide.

anya_platform: Rough numbers: shared-burst = hosted*2.5 + GPU-hour premium; dedicated-reserve = discounted monthly rate amortized; I'll ping finance for exact digits and post here.

rahul_eng_runtime: Meanwhile I'll prepare a one-line patch customers can `kubectl apply` to inject the registry pull secret into node bootstrap and a bootstrap script to ensure the expected NVIDIA driver is present (we'll surface exact driver version).

leo_support: I'll open the quota ticket and flag for expedited review. Please DM the cloud account/project id.

tara_sales: I'll get account id now and confirm whether they can accept a shifted region fallback. Ethos said "no", Cerulean insists on ap-south1.

marie_cs: Please keep me posted. We need a go/no-go by EOD for the demo.

anya_platform: TL;DR action items: quota ticket (leo), pricing/legal check (anya), bootstrap secret + driver patch (rahul). Post updates here.

tara_sales: Thanks all 64f3fb
